glossary.definition: (B) As used in this section, "accounts" includes, but is not limited to, final judgments, fringe benefits payments due and payable, amounts due and payable to persons and other governmental entities, and any interest and penalties on those judgments, payments, or amounts. Accounts that are due and payable do not include any account, or portion of any account, that is being contested in good faith.
